description: This file defines an interface for a TypeScript parser library, specifying methods for parsing source code into class definitions, extracting variable definitions, and converting class definitions to string representation.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses TypeScript source code into a class definition.

methods.name: Variables
methods.description: Extracts variable definitions from TypeScript source code.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a class definition to its string representation.
